title: 223-229 East Main Street, 223-229 East Main Street, Madison, Jefferson County, IN
notes: Significance: Excellent surviving examples of mid-to-late nineteenth century commercial architecture, this block of four stores was built with a continuous facade and cast-iron storefronts, of which only one survives.
Unprocessed Field note material exists for this structure: FN-55
